heading: Tuesday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy, becoming mostly cloudy late in the north. Lows in the low to mid 50s, with some upper 40s northeast. Winds becoming light, variable to southeast, except south to southeast 5 to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday
text: Mostly cloudy. A sprinkle possible; otherwise showers becoming likely by late morning in the St. Lawrence Valley, chance elsewhere west of the Greens in the afternoon, and a slight chance east. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, some upper 70s far south. South winds gusting 25 mph, except to 35 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy. Showers likely and maybe a thunderstorm, except diminishing early in the St. Lawrence Valley. Lows in the low to mid 60s. Winds becoming southwest 10 to 15 mph.
